svg.title: U for UI Kit and Design System
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold U fills with a cream interface, including a button, typography, a toggle and colour tokens. A cursor selects the button. The U then moves left as the UI Kit and Design System heading and illustrations of tokens, components and patterns appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. U, cream interface, blue background and red pointer adapted from 21_U_ui_ux_design.png. All artwork, animation and typography embedded; no external assets. Interface examples are illustrative.
